scope: Issuer statement revisions before payment allocation and immutable lock afterwards
behavior: An unallocated issuer statement can revise its close date, due date and issuer-confirmed amount while retaining the same statement ID
Each accepted revision increments the revision number and the latest revision becomes the authoritative read
An ambiguously acknowledged revision can be retried after restart without appending a duplicate revision
Any existing payment allocation makes the statement immutable at both the formal screen and persistence boundary
Remaining due is recalculated from the latest issuer-confirmed revision before allocation
